name: @repo/platform-cloudflare
description: The Cloudflare adapters for the @repo/platform ports: D1 (and R2 from commit 5) behind Db and BlobStore, the Worker env as Config, ctx.waitUntil as defer. platform.ts builds a platform from any Worker's env; next.ts is the OpenNext wrapper behind @repo/platform/current. Only the files allowed by the platform-boundary guard may import this package. testing/ is test-only.
